new_findings.summary: index.json addresses block reports pre-D28 byte figures: bytes.shards 45,783,814 and bytes.a 87,515,990; largest_shard r0075_c01871 181,786 B. On disk hail/a holds 7,520,429 B; the largest is r0098_c0207 at 158,526 B, and r0075_c01871 is now 1,818 B. Cause: the addresses module writes the block before the buildings module's a/ rewrite (D28), and the rewrite does not update that block. verify does not check these fields. Fix: recompute the block after the rewrite, or have verify compare them with disk.

Search for '401 N 27th St Billings' lists two identical rows '401 North 27th Street, Billings 59101' (both class S, positions about 7 m apart). The merge rule merges only identical positions, so the list shows two lines that look the same.
